subject_uz: Toshkent shahri Bektemir tumanida 120 o'rinli maktabgacha ta'lim tashkiloti (MTT) binosini qurish

requirements.summary_uz: ISO 9001 sertifikatiga ega bo'lish va uni ilova qilish ball beradi (ISO 14001 va ISO 45001 ham shunday).
requirements.summary_en: Holding and attaching an ISO 9001 certificate earns points (ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 likewise).

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi 5 yildagi o'rtacha yillik aylanma 1 million AQSh dollari ekvivalentida bo'lishi baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Average annual turnover over the last 5 years of USD 1 million equivalent is scored.
requirements.quote: Oxirgi 5 yildagi o‘rtacha yillik aylanmasi 1 million AQSh dollari ekvivalentida

requirements.summary_uz: Bankdan aylanma mablag'lar haqida ma'lumotnoma kerak; mablag' xarid qiymatining kamida 20 foiziga teng bo'lishi lozim.
requirements.summary_en: A bank certificate of working funds is needed; the amount must be at least 20% of the procurement value.
requirements.quote: mablag‘ miqdori xarid predmeti qiymatining kamida 20% teng bo‘lishi zarur

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi 3 yilda bajarilgan obyektlar haqida ma'lumot davlat qabul hay'ati dalolatnomalari bilan taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: Information on objects completed in the last 3 years is submitted with state acceptance commission acts.
requirements.quote: Namuna jadvalga asosan oxirgi 3 yilda bajargan obyektlari to‘g‘risida ma’lumot

requirements.summary_uz: Maydoni 5000 m2 va CAPEX 1 mln dollar bo'lgan 5 tadan ko'p obyekt tajribasi ball beradi (kafolat xati bilan).
requirements.summary_en: Experience on more than 5 objects of 5,000 sq m and USD 1 million CAPEX earns points (with a guarantee letter).
requirements.quote: Oxirgi 15 yilda 5 tadan ko‘p, maydoni 5000 m2 bo‘lgan, kapital xarajatlari (CAPEX) 1,0 mln. AQSh dollari ekvivalentida bo‘lgan

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi 10 yilda 5 ta va undan ko'p obyektda qurilish-ta'mirlash ishlari (isitish, izolyatsiya, quyosh paneli) baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: Building and repair work on 5 or more objects in the last 10 years (heating, insulation, solar panels) is scored.
requirements.quote: 5 ta va undan ko‘p obyektlarda qurilish-taʼmirlash ishlarini bajarganligi

requirements.summary_uz: Qurilish-pudrat tashkilotlari elektron reytingi: CCC va undan yuqori 10 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Electronic contractor rating: CCC or higher earns 10 points.
requirements.quote: Reyting darajasi: CCC va undan yuqori bo‘lsa – 10 ball

requirements.summary_uz: Direktor kamida 5 yillik tajribali oliy ma'lumotli muhandis-quruvchi bo'lishi kerak; boshqa asosiy xodimlar ham ko'rsatiladi.
requirements.summary_en: The director must be a higher-educated construction engineer with at least 5 years' experience; other key staff are also listed.
requirements.quote: Direktor (Ish tajribasi 5 yil yoki undan yuqori bo‘lgan oliy ma’lumotga ega muhandis quruvchi)

requirements.summary_uz: Energiya samaradorligi bo'yicha milliy sertifikatga ega xodim ilova qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: An employee holding a national energy-efficiency certificate is to be attached.
requirements.quote: Energiya samaradorligi bo‘yicha sertifikati (milliy) mavjud hodim (Ilova qilinadi)

requirements.summary_uz: Qurilish obyektini ko'zdan kechirganlik haqida ma'lumotnoma (rasmlar bilan) taqdim etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: A site-inspection certificate with photos of the object is submitted.
requirements.quote: Qurilish (ta’mirlash) obyektini ko‘zdan kechirganlik to‘g‘risida ma’lumotnoma

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlar shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlab 210 kunda bajariladi.
requirements.summary_en: Works must be completed within 210 days of contract signature.

requirements.summary_uz: Moliyalashtirish: 30 foiz avans, 65 foiz joriy moliyalashtirish, 5 foiz kafolat muddatidan keyin.
requirements.summary_en: Financing: 30% advance, 65% progress payments, 5% after the warranty period.

requirements.summary_uz: Qurilish ishlarining kamida 50 foizi ishtirokchining o'z kuchi bilan bajarilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: At least 50% of the construction work must be performed with the bidder's own resources.
requirements.quote: qurilish ishlarining kamida 50 %ini oʻz kuchimiz bilan

flags.quote: Oxirgi 15 yilda 5 tadan ko‘p, maydoni 5000 m2 bo‘lgan, kapital xarajatlari (CAPEX) 1,0 mln. AQSh dollari ekvivalentida bo‘lgan
flags.explanation_uz: Tajriba mezonining bir bandi maydoni 5000 m2 va undan katta, qiymati kamida 1 mln AQSh dollari bo'lgan obyektlarni bajarganlik uchun 5 ball, kichikroq obyektlar uchun 1 ball beradi. Quriladigan bog'cha binolarining umumiy maydoni taxminan 1 274 m2 (1 116 m2 va 158 m2), ya'ni so'ralgan obyektlardan to'rt baravar kichik. Farq 85 balldan 4 ballni tashkil etadi, shu sababli ta'siri cheklangan; talab lot hajmiga mosligini aniqlashtirish mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: One part of the experience criterion gives 5 points for completed objects of 5,000 sq m or more costing at least USD 1 million, and 1 point for smaller ones. The kindergarten buildings to be built total about 1,274 sq m (1,116 and 158), a quarter of that size. The gap is 4 points out of 85, so the effect is limited; it is worth asking whether the threshold fits the lot.
flags.rewrite_uz: Oxirgi 10 yilda umumiy maydoni kamida 1000 m2 bo'lgan, ijtimoiy yoki fuqarolik maqsadidagi kamida 2 ta obyektni qurish yoki ta'mirlash tajribasi (davlat qabul hay'ati dalolatnomalari bilan) ball beradi.
flags.rewrite_en: Experience building or renovating at least 2 social or civil objects of at least 1,000 sq m each in the last 10 years (with state acceptance acts) earns points.

documents_needed_uz: 2-shakl: oxirgi 5 yillik moliyaviy ko'rsatkichlar, hisobot yoki audit xulosasi
Xizmat ko'rsatuvchi bankdan aylanma mablag'lar haqida ma'lumotnoma
3-shakl: bajarilgan obyektlar, davlat qabul hay'ati dalolatnomalari, kafolat xatlari
5-shakl: xodimlar, elektron mehnat daftarchalari va diplom nusxalari, energiya samaradorligi sertifikati
6-shakl: obyektni ko'zdan kechirganlik haqida ma'lumotnoma (rasmlar bilan)
Soliq qarzi yo'qligi va insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida yo'qligi haqida ma'lumotlar

second_pass.note: severity lowered from medium to low: only 4 of 85 points depend on the threshold, and the lot itself is large (start price 9.68 bn UZS)
